query: select l.id as lesson_id, l.title as lesson_title, l.created_at as lesson_created_at, l.updated_at as lesson_updated_at, l.is_active as lesson_is_active, c.id as chapter_id, c.title as chapter_title, c.subject_offering_id, coalesce(sub_direct.name, sub_offering.name) as subject_name, coalesce(lv_direct.name, lv_offering.name) as level_name, coalesce(s_direct.name, s_offering.name) as series_name, case when c.subject_offering_id is null then 'liaison directe chapitre' else 'liaison par offre de matière' end as pedagogical_link_mode from public.lessons l join public.chapters c on c.id = l.chapter_id left join public.subjects sub_direct on sub_direct.id = c.subject_id left join public.levels lv_direct on lv_direct.id = c.level_id left join public.series s_direct on s_direct.id = c.series_id left join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id = c.subject_offering_id left join public.subjects sub_offering on sub_offering.id = o.subject_id left join public.levels lv_offering on lv_offering.id = o.level_id left join public.series s_offering on s_offering.id = o.series_id where l.id in ('fe364cab-7eac-4d14-9c6f-ee279cc92750','dac94865-5803-4ae6-b241-c9a2844633ae') order by l.id limit 2;
